data.rationale: The proposal follows the same Wikipedia → Booking.com → Notes procedure with the right parameters and note format, but it drops the "first property with review score ≥ 8" criterion and the do-not-reserve constraint, assumes a one-night stay instead of a separate checkout parameter, and leaves the hotel choice vague ("chosen hotel"), so an automation built from it alone would be underspecified.
